params.message:
Study by voice: a study conversation from the voice screen

The voice screen gets a second start, Study. It lists the courses the voice
bridge offers (GET /study) with what studying by voice cost this month
against its cap, and one tap on a course starts a study conversation:
POST /session {mode: "study", course, microphone?}. The bridge mints the same
realtime voice with the study service's instructions and its three tools
only; the app connects as it does for the work voice.

In a study conversation the voice opens (speaksFirst), tool calls go through
POST /act unchanged, and nothing is written into the work conversation: no
transcript, no notices, no typed lines. The screen shows the course, the
topic the study service is on, whether the voice speaks or waits, the time
and one large Stop. When the study service ends the session, the app closes
the conversation after the voice's last words.

What the realtime API reports as used (response.done, transcription
completed) is sent to the bridge once per event id (POST /usage), for the
work voice too, because the session runs between the phone and OpenAI and
the bridge's ledger and monthly cap can only count what the phone reports.
When the bridge answers that the cap is reached the running session goes on,
the app says so once and offers no new one. A refusal from the bridge (cap,
unknown course, study service out of reach) is shown in the bridge's own
sentence.

The end of a conversation is now told to the bridge outside the service's
scope, so it is also told when the service is already gone.
